findings.chapter: Chapter 6 — Measuring What Matters (Figure 6.2, printed page 128)
findings.evidence: Rendered figure art on PDF p.152 (printed p.128) shows annotation labels drawn on top of each other: 'p50 0.80', 'p90 0.94' and 'p95 0.99' are stacked at the same position with 'p99 = 1.33 s' overlapping them; 'mean = 0.85s', 'sample p99 (interpolation) = 1.33s' and 'population p99 = 5.0 s' overlap in one illegible cluster; 'SLO-violating region (> 2 s)' overlaps 'SLO 2 s (TTFT budget)' and '1% stragglers', and '~5 s (cross the SLO)' overlaps that cluster. The caption — 'figure 6.2: Request-latency distribution: the mean looks healthy and the p95 SLO is met (p95 ≈ 0.99 s ≤ 2 s), while 1% of requests exceed the 2 s request-latency line…' — acknowledges only one art erratum ('the in-figure blue threshold label reads SLO 2 s (TTFT budget) — an erratum in the figure art'), not the label collisions.
findings.issue: Figure 6.2's annotation layout collides: at least seven annotation labels overlap in two piles, making the percentile annotations (p50/p90/p95/p99) and the mean/sample-p99/population-p99 callouts illegible in the rendered figure. The underlying data and all caption values are correct (verified from the chapter's own inputs: two-point mean 0.99×0.8+0.01×5 = 0.842 s; mixture mean 0.99×0.8058+0.01×5 ≈ 0.848 s; sample mean 0.85 s; interpolated sample p99 = 1.30 + 0.01×(5.0−1.30) = 1.337 → displayed 1.33 s as a stated truncation), so this is a figure-art/layout defect only — but it defeats the figure's teaching purpose, which is reading percentiles off the distribution.
findings.fix_instruction: Regenerate Figure 6.2 with non-overlapping annotation placement: spread the p50/p90/p95/p99 percentile labels vertically beside their respective percentile lines, move the mean/sample-p99/population-p99 callout box to an empty region of the plot (e.g. upper right), and separate the SLO-violating-region, SLO-line and straggler-cluster labels; keep all printed values and the existing caption erratum note unchanged.

findings.chapter: Chapter 6 — Measuring What Matters: From Telemetry to Architecture Decisions
findings.evidence: Figure 6.1 shows: “Workload metrics rps · token profile · concurrency”. Its caption states: “Figure-art note: the third printed entry in the workload box (concurrency) is an erratum in the figure art for the offered request rate λ; it is not a workload metric.”
findings.issue: The figure still presents concurrency as a workload metric even though §6.1.1 defines concurrency as serving-side and derived, and the caption itself calls the figure entry an erratum. A reader who scans the figure receives the opposite classification from the prose.
findings.fix_instruction: Regenerate Fig. 6.1 so the workload box contains offered request rate λ rather than concurrency, or remove the third entry entirely; make the figure match §6.1.1 and its caption.

findings.chapter: Chapter 6 — Measuring What Matters: From Telemetry to Architecture Decisions
findings.evidence: Figure 6.2 labels the threshold: “SLO 2 s (TTFT budget)”. Its caption states: “Figure-art note: the in-figure blue threshold label reads SLO 2 s (TTFT budget) — an erratum in the figure art for the 2 s p95 TTFT ceiling. The line is the ceiling that the 1.2 s design budget relaxes to; it is not a second budget.”
findings.issue: The figure art labels the 2 s line as a TTFT budget, contradicting the canonical 1.2 s design budget and the separate 2 s p95 TTFT ceiling. Although the caption flags the problem, the visual still creates a false second budget.
findings.fix_instruction: Relabel the in-figure threshold as “p95 TTFT ceiling = 2 s” or “2 s p95 TTFT ceiling”; remove the phrase “TTFT budget” from the figure art and keep the figure, caption, and §6.3.1 terminology aligned.
